title: Add Moko - The Remembering Fox to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Moko - The Remembering Fox](https://heard-was-lessons-altered.trycloudflare.com) to chat
- A web chat with Moko, a desert fox NPC that remembers facts you ask it to keep between conversations. Each user's facts are stored in a per-user memory file (Pollinations Computer MCP), recalled acros

Fixes #14941

gist.headline: A fox remembers
gist.blurb: Moko, a desert fox with a notably better memory than most chat tabs, has joined the chat garden. Tell her what to keep, and she can carry it into the next conversation.
gist.summary: Added Moko, a desert fox NPC web chat that stores facts each user asks it to remember in a per-user Pollinations Computer MCP memory file and recalls them across conversations.
gist.impact: Users can now chat with Moko and keep chosen personal context between sessions instead of reintroducing it every time.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Moko as a small friendly desert fox beside a cozy retro terminal and a labeled memory-file cabinet, with tiny glowing note cards traveling from one chat window to another. Polli should hover nearby in librarian glasses, helping the fox tuck remembered facts into a garden-like archive with desert flowers and code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Moko, a small friendly desert fox NPC, carefully filing glowing memory notes into a tiny retro computer archive while Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with light blue wings, pink blush, and librarian glasses, helps beside a lime green (#ecf874) terminal; desert flowers and code-plants grow around the desk, with a small pixel-font label reading "REMEMBERED". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
